name: @jayjnu/simple-worktree
description: Config-driven Git worktree bootstrap and cleanup CLI.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/bin/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node test/cli.test.mjs && node test/core-ports.test.mjs && node test/worktree.test.mjs
